result.rationale: Statement [1] explicitly states pIC50 = 1/IC50(M), the exact erroneous formula lacking the log transformation, so a reviewer could catch the defect from this statement alone.
System correctly identifies that Eq.1 omits the log10, giving pIC50=1/IC50 instead of pIC50=log(1/IC50), matching the annotated defect exactly, with additional supporting numerical arguments.
